title: RL 负载的有功、无功与功率因数
statement: 正弦电压源 U̇_s = 100∠0° V（有效值），角频率 ω = 1000 rad/s，向 R = 6 Ω 与 L = 8 mH 串联的负载供电。
求电流有效值、电阻吸收的有功功率、电感吸收的无功功率，以及电源看到的功率因数。

en.title: Real power, reactive power and power factor of an RL load
statement: A sinusoidal source U̇_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, feeds a load made of R = 6 Ω in series with L = 8 mH.
Find the rms current, the real power absorbed by the resistor, the reactive power absorbed by the inductor, and the power factor seen by the source.

questions.ask: Real power absorbed by R, P = ?
Reactive power absorbed by L, Q = ?
Power factor seen by the source, λ = cos φ = ?
To raise the power factor without changing the load, what do we usually connect?
choices: A capacitor in parallel with the load
An inductor in series with the load
A resistor in parallel with the load
choiceExplain: A series inductor adds more inductive reactive power, lowering the power factor further, and changes the voltage across the load; compensation needs a capacitor (negative Q), connected in parallel so the load is undisturbed.
A parallel resistor only adds real power and does nothing to the 800 var; it nudges cos φ up by wasting energy, so it is never used for this.
questions.explain: A parallel capacitor supplies reactive power locally (negative Q), cancelling part of the load's 800 var, so the source sees a smaller current and a higher power factor.

hints: First find X_L = ωL and the impedance Z = R + jX_L.
With rms phasors: P = I²R, Q = I²X, S = U·I, cos φ = P / S.
solution: **2. Current.** I = U / |Z| = 100 / 10 = **10 A** (rms), lagging the voltage by 53.13°.
**3. Power.** P = I²R = **600 W**; Q = I²X_L = **800 var**; S = U·I = 1000 VA; check S² = P² + Q².
**4. Power factor.** λ = cos 53.13° = P / S = **0.6** (lagging).

questions.ask: 电阻吸收的有功功率 P = ?
电感吸收的无功功率 Q = ?
电源看到的功率因数 λ = cos φ = ?
不改变负载本身，想提高功率因数，通常怎么做？
choiceExplain: 串联电感会再增加感性无功功率，使功率因数更低，还会改变负载两端的电压；补偿要用无功为负的电容，而且并联才不影响负载。
并联电阻只增加有功功率、不减少 800 var 的无功，靠白白消耗能量把 cos φ 抬高一点，实际不会这样做。
questions.explain: 并联电容就地提供无功功率（Q 为负），抵消负载的一部分 800 var，电源电流减小、功率因数提高。

hints: 先算 X_L = ωL，再写出阻抗 Z = R + jX_L。
用有效值相量：P = I²R，Q = I²X，S = U·I，cos φ = P / S。
solution: **3. 功率。** P = I²R = **600 W**；Q = I²X_L = **800 var**；S = U·I = 1000 VA，满足 S² = P² + Q²。
